mapper.select: SELECT 'MENU' AS targetType, m.id AS targetId, m.name, c.name AS category, m.sold_out AS isSoldOut, ma.url AS imageUrl FROM menu m JOIN category c ON c.id = m.cat_id LEFT JOIN media_asset ma ON ma.id = m.image_asset_id AND ma.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'INGREDIENT' AS targetType, i.id AS targetId, i.name, COALESCE(cc.name, '재료') AS category, i.sold_out AS isSoldOut, ma.url AS imageUrl FROM ingredient i LEFT JOIN common_code cc ON cc.id = i.type_id LEFT JOIN media_asset ma ON ma.id = i.photo_asset_id AND ma.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'OPTION_ITEM' AS targetType, oi.id AS targetId, oi.name, og.name AS category, oi.sold_out AS isSoldOut, oi.icon_url AS imageUrl FROM opt_item oi JOIN opt_group og ON og.id = oi.opt_group_id ORDER BY targetType, category, name
mapper.update: UPDATE menu SET sold_out = #{isSoldOut} WHERE id = #{targetId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE ingredient SET sold_out = #{isSoldOut} WHERE id = #{targetId}
UPDATE opt_item SET sold_out = #{isSoldOut} WHERE id = #{targetId}
